Parts.Description: Dark volcanic rock with lava streams, glowing path plates and a golden plaza under the Dragon Shiba.
Parts.Name: Lair Floor

Parts.Description: A huge rock mountain with a fanged cave mouth, the home of the Dragon Shiba.
Parts.Name: Dragon Cave

Parts.Description: A glittering heap of gold, gems and chests spilling out of the cave mouth.
Parts.Name: Gold Hoard

Parts.Description: Three iron fire bowls of different heights burning beside the entrance.
Parts.Name: Fire Braziers

Parts.Description: A twig nest on a bed of hay with three speckled dragon eggs.
Parts.Name: Dragon Nest

Parts.Description: Jagged rock spikes of all sizes growing out of the cave floor.
Parts.Name: Rock Spikes

Parts.Description: The huge rib cage and skull of an ancient dragon lying in the dust.
Parts.Name: Dragon Ribs

Parts.Description: A bubbling pool of lava ringed by dark rocks.
Parts.Name: Lava Pool

Parts.Description: A gate of giant bones with skulls arching over the walkway.
Parts.Name: Skull Gate

Parts.Description: A cluster of tall green crystals with one ruby among them.
Parts.Name: Emerald Crystals

Parts.Description: Dented armor of brave knights left standing and lying around, with a broken shield and spear.
Parts.Name: Knight Armor Graveyard

Parts.Description: Three chests of different sizes with gold spilling out of them.
Parts.Name: Treasure Chests

Parts.Description: Six swords of fallen heroes stuck in a heap of rubble at different angles.
Parts.Name: Swords in the Rubble

Parts.Description: A stone smithy with a glowing furnace, a tall chimney, an anvil and a barrel of coal.
Parts.Name: Dragonsmith Forge

Parts.Description: Four tall poles with red and green dragon banners flapping in the heat.
Parts.Name: Dragon Banners

Parts.Description: A crumbling stone watchtower with a broken top, a tattered banner and a glowing window.
Parts.Name: Ruined Watchtower

Parts.Description: A little green dragon with tiny wings and horns napping on a rock.
Parts.Name: Baby Dragon

Parts.Description: A throne of dragon bones on a stone dais with skulls on the armrests and a golden crown.
Parts.Name: Bone Throne

Parts.Description: Four towers of stacked gold coins with a ruby on top and loose coins around.
Parts.Name: Coin Towers

Parts.Description: A ring of tilted standing stones around a glowing purple rune stone.
Parts.Name: Rune Circle

Parts.Description: Two giant dragon wings of bone and green membrane rising from the rocks.
Parts.Name: Wing Arches

Parts.Description: A huge dragon skull with horns and fangs that stares toward the road.
Parts.Name: Giant Dragon Skull

Parts.Description: Tall black glass spires of different heights growing out of a rocky mound.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Spires

Parts.Description: A dark stone castle with four round towers, green scale roofs, a dragon head over the gate and a lava window.
Parts.Name: Dragon Keep

Parts.Description: A wooden catapult with a stone counterweight, its last boulder still in the bucket.
Parts.Name: Siege Catapult

Parts.Description: A mossy stone statue of a dragon slayer holding up his sword on a pedestal.
Parts.Name: Slayer Statue

Parts.Description: A small volcano of stacked rock with a lava crater, two lava streams and flying embers.
Parts.Name: Smoking Volcano

Parts.Description: A wooden wagon heaped with gold that a brave thief never got away with.
Parts.Name: Loot Wagon

Parts.Description: Tall cave mushrooms with teal and purple caps growing around a mossy rock.
Parts.Name: Cave Mushrooms

Parts.Description: The landmark: a giant green dragon with spread wings perched on top of the cave, breathing fire at the sky.
Parts.Name: The Great Dragon
